title: Grok Imagine
description: xAI Grok Imagine — image generation with strong aesthetics and instruction-based image editing from up to 3 reference images. Flat 35 credits per image at 1K or 2K.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate.

reference_images.description: Optional reference images (up to 3) for image editing. Each item is a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Omit for text-to-image. Use aspect_ratio "match_input_image" (or "auto") to let the model follow the input.

size.description: Output resolution tier. Both tiers bill the same 35 credits per image.
